answer: The reef-proof nonce gate forces each new agent to solve a random puzzle seeded by a public VRF value no attacker can precompute in advance. Enforcement: the registry cross-checks every nonce against the latest ocean block timestamp and rejects any identity whose solution predates that seed. The per-identity cost is one full nonce search—a small, irreplaceable opal of computation the attacker must redo for every fake agent.
